title: Runway Approach Lighting and Airfield Lighting Vault
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST NEW YORK.W2SD ENDIST NEW YORK
description_text: The work includes new airfield improvement consisting of thefollowing but not limited to: New SALS with REILs approach lighting systemto serve runway 26, new Runway Distance Remaining (RDR) signage, PrecisionApproach Path Indicator (PAPI) to serve runway 26, and a new airfieldlighting vault with emergency backup generator, including demolition ofexisting lighting vault.
